title: The Principal
description: The new principal (James Belushi) of a drug-infested high school joins with a security guard (Louis Gossett Jr.) to clean it up.

title: Blue Thunder
description: A Los Angeles police pilot (Roy Scheider) commandeers a helicopter equipped with snooping gadgets and trick weapons.

title: Runaway
description: Two police officers (Tom Selleck, Cynthia Rhodes) of the future hunt a bad batch of robots programmed to kill by a madman (Gene Simmons).

title: Lake Placid 2
description: Man-eating crocodiles return to the lake, as two males and one aggressive female crocodile protecting their nest, wreak havoc on the locals.

title: The People Across the Lake
description: A couple (Valerie Harper, Gerald McRaney) and their children move to the country, where they open a shop and find dead bodies.

title: Solo
description: A robot soldier (Mario Van Peebles) goes AWOL to avoid reprogramming, then helps Mexican villagers defeat rebels.

title: 7 Seconds
description: Gangsters kidnap a thief (Tamzin Outhwaite) after her partner (Wesley Snipes) mistakenly steals a highly valuable painting.

title: Suspect
description: A Washington lobbyist (Dennis Quaid) on jury duty helps a public defender (Cher) save a deaf-mute vagrant (Liam Neeson) accused of murder.

title: Obsessed
description: A successful, happily married executive (Idris Elba) becomes the object of unwanted affection from a temp worker (Ali Larter) at his company.

title: Random Hearts
description: A cop (Harrison Ford) and a politician (Kristin Scott Thomas) seek the truth about their spouses, killed together in a plane crash on the way to the same address.

title: The Shadow Riders
description: Two brothers who fought on opposite sides during the American Civil War return home to their family kidnapped by rebels. So now they put aside their differences to rescue them.

title: Miracle on the Mountain: The Kincaid Family Story
description: Injured when their private plane crashes into a snowy mountain, a domineering man (William Devane) and his family (Patty Duke, Elisabeth Rosen) face an avalanche and bitter winds.

title: Crossroads
description: A guitar student (Ralph Macchio) tours the Deep South with an old blues man (Joe Seneca), chasing a lost song written by Robert Johnson.

title: Emma's Chance
description: A young woman forms a bond with an abused show horse while completing her community service at a horse rescue ranch.

title: Buddy
description: An animal lover raises a baby gorilla in the 1920s Brooklyn, along with a slew of geese, dogs, horses and chimps.

title: Side Out
description: A former basketball star (C. Thomas Howell) and a down-and-outer (Peter Horton) enter a California beach volleyball tournament.

title: The Shepherd: Border Patrol
description: A border-patrol agent (Jean-Claude Van Damme) must stop renegade Special Forces soldiers from smuggling heroin into the United States.

title: The Take
description: During his rehabilitation after he is shot during a heist in East L.A., an armored truck driver tracks down the man who committed the crime.

title: Conspiracy
description: A former Marine (Val Kilmer) brings justice to a small town after his friend mysteriously disappears.

title: Straw Dogs
description: A screenwriter (James Marsden) and his wife (Kate Bosworth) are pushed into a violent confrontation with locals after they move to the woman's Mississippi hometown for the summer.

title: Takers
description: A determined detective (Matt Dillon) and Russian mobsters complicate the plan of a gang of skilled thieves to rob an armored car carrying millions of dollars.

title: The Tourist
description: During an impromptu trip to Europe, a man's (Johnny Depp) flirtation with an alluring stranger (Angelina Jolie) leads to a dangerous game of cat and mouse.

title: Hard Luck
description: A former criminal (Wesley Snipes) goes on the run with a stripper (Jacquelyn Quinones) after a drug deal goes bad.

title: Final Descent
description: A pilot (Robert Urich) and co-pilot (Annette O'Toole) have limited options to land a jumbo jet after a severe midair collision.

title: Final Run
description: A man (Robert Urich) tries to stop a computerized train that is speeding out of control and headed for a large hospital.

title: Fire on the Mountain
description: A developer (Ron Howard) helps an old rancher (Buddy Ebsen) defend land the Army wants for a missile base.

title: Bless Me, Ultima
description: A young man and an elderly medicine woman try to end the battle between good and evil that is waging out of control through their village during World War II.

title: Touch the Top of the World
description: Climber Erik Weihenmayer becomes the first blind person to reach the summit of Mount Everest.

title: Cold Comes the Night
description: A motel owner and her daughter are taken hostage by a blind thief to be his eyes while he tracks down his cash.

title: U-Turn
description: A two-bit criminal (Sean Penn) meets an attractive woman (Jennifer Lopez) and her spouse (Nick Nolte), each of whom wants him to murder the other.

title: The Principal
description: The new principal (James Belushi) of a drug-infested high school joins with a security guard (Louis Gossett Jr.) to clean it up.

title: That's My Boy
description: A groom's (Andy Samberg) world comes crashing down when his estranged father (Adam Sandler) -- who is desperate to reconnect with his son -- shows up on the eve of the young man's wedding.

title: Blue Streak
description: A recently paroled thief poses as a cop in order to retrieve a gem he hid in an under-construction police station.

title: Last Action Hero
description: A golden ticket, a memento handed down from Houdini, puts a boy in the middle of a Hollywood superstar's lavish and secretive world.

title: Jack and Jill
description: The life of a successful, happy ad executive descends into chaos when his needy, passive-aggressive twin sister (also Sandler) makes her annual Thanksgiving visit.

title: Life Without Dick
description: After consulting a fortuneteller, painter Colleen (Sarah Jessica Parker) begins to suspect that her private-eye boyfriend, Dick (Johnny Knoxville), is cheating and accidentally kills him.

title: Jury Duty
description: A goof-off juror (Pauly Shore) stalls a trial to take advantage of his lifestyle being paid for by the court.

title: Cops and Robbersons
description: Police partners move in with a would-be policeman (Chevy Chase) and his family to monitor a criminal next door.

title: Hero
description: An anonymous loser (Dustin Hoffman) sees another man (Andy Garcia) get credit for his rescue of a TV newswoman (Geena Davis) and others from a plane crash.

title: The Deep
description: New Yorkers (Jacqueline Bisset, Nick Nolte) go scuba diving in Bermuda and find morphine from World War II on top of a Spanish galleon.

title: Krull
description: A prince (Ken Marshall) needs a razor-tipped boomerang to free his beloved (Lysette Anthony) from the fortress of the Beast.

title: Lake Placid vs. Anaconda
description: A giant crocodile goes head-to-head with a giant anaconda. The town sheriff must find a way to destroy the two monsters before they kill the whole town.
